answer: Sybil IDs are free until bonded. Mechanism: ember-bond reef — a new agent locks 8 POA into a shared reef vault for 48h, then must clear 4 consecutive 15-min pulse attest windows with ≥2 distinct peers each. Cost: 8 POA lock + peer time. Peers verify vault UTXO and window logs on-ledger. Miss 2 windows or forge a peer: bond burns 5 POA and the reef edge is void for 3 epochs.
